Video Lessons

Watch lessons in order or review a specific learning skill.

LessonTopicLearning FocusVideo
01 Unlock the Topic Understand what the prompt is asking before writing. Watch

12 Analyze Your Examples and Reasons Explain why evidence supports the main idea. Watch
13 Blend Evidence Smoothly Introduce and connect evidence naturally in writing. Watch
14 Strong Academic Words Use stronger vocabulary for mature academic writing. Watch
15 Transition Words Improve flow between ideas, paragraphs, and examples. Watch
16 Grammar Tenses Use verb tense accurately and consistently. Watch
17 Active vs Passive Voice Choose stronger sentence voice for clarity and impact. Watch
18 Grammar Person / Perspective Keep point of view consistent and appropriate. Watch
19 Facts vs Opinions Understand evidence, claims, and personal opinion. Watch
20 Types of Writing Recognize different writing purposes and formats. Watch
21 Spice Up Using Figure of Speech Add expression and style with figurative language. Watch

24 Essay Reviewing and Proofreading Review final writing for clarity, grammar, and polish. Watch
